Home Technology

A house is just a smaller estate

Smart homes fail for the same reason office networks fail: someone bolted the clever part onto infrastructure that couldn't carry it. We build the network first — then everything sitting on top of it stays up.

Independent by choice. We aren't a single-brand dealership, so we're not obliged to sell you one manufacturer's ecosystem. We specify what suits the property, the budget and the way you actually live — and you keep the freedom to change direction later.

Home Networking

Full-property Wi-Fi, structured cabling and wired backhaul that holds under load.

Home Assistant

One system for the whole house. Run locally, owned by you.

Home Assistant is the open-source platform we use to pull a home together. Lighting, heating, cameras, blinds, audio and energy all sit behind one app and one set of automations, whatever brand each device happens to be. It runs on a small dedicated box in your home rather than someone else's cloud, and it can sit alongside an existing Control4 system too.

Local first

Keeps working when the internet doesn't. Your automations and cameras stay inside the house, not on a manufacturer's server.

Any brand

Thousands of integrations. Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread and Matter, plus names like Philips Hue, Sonos, tado°, Hive, Ring and UniFi. Keep what you already own.

Control4

Works with Control4. Bring an existing Control4 system into Home Assistant and add the devices Control4 doesn't cover.

No lock-in

No compulsory subscription and no proprietary controller. It's documented and handed over, so you're never dependent on us.

About CTM Tech

Eighteen years of enterprise habits

CTM Tech has served Hertfordshire since 2016. Behind it sits 18 years inside corporate IT environments — the kind where downtime is counted in pounds per minute and a badly segmented network becomes a board-level problem.

That background shapes everything here. Most small businesses inherit their IT by accident: a router from the broadband provider, a firewall nobody has logged into since install, laptops running whatever came in the box. It works right up until it very much doesn't. We bring corporate standards down to SMB scale and SMB budgets — and we document what we build, so you're never held hostage by the only person who understands it.

The same principles carry into the home. A smart home is an estate with fewer users and higher expectations, and it deserves a properly designed network underneath it just as much as an office does.

FAQ

Common questions

Do I have to sign a long-term support contract?

No. Work can be a one-off project, occasional ad-hoc support or a fully managed arrangement. Contracts are flexible, with no lock-in.

We already have someone who "does the IT". Can you still help?

Yes. Many engagements start with a review of what's already there, and we're happy to work alongside an existing provider or an in-house person. Everything we build is documented, so no single person becomes a bottleneck.

Which areas do you cover?

We're based in Hertfordshire and cover the county and its borders, including St Albans, Watford, Hemel Hempstead, Stevenage, Hertford, Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City, Harpenden, Berkhamsted, Bishop's Stortford, Potters Bar and Tring. Every enquiry gets a reply within one business day.

Can you help us use AI safely?

Yes. We start by making sure AI tools can only see what each person should see, then roll out Copilot, custom agents or automations with clear policies on what data goes where.

Why Home Assistant rather than a single-brand smart home system?

It works with almost any brand, runs locally so it keeps working without the internet, and doesn't tie you to one manufacturer's app or subscription. It can also run alongside an existing Control4 system.

I set up Home Assistant myself and it's become unreliable. Can you fix it?

Yes. We regularly move hobby installs onto proper hardware, sort out flaky Zigbee and Wi-Fi coverage, set up automatic backups and document the result. You keep your existing devices and automations wherever it makes sense.
